- LMC distance ≈ \(1.6\times10^5\) light-years  
- \(\beta=0.99999987\), so

- Proper travel time:
  \[
  \tau \approx \frac{1.6\times10^5\ \text{yr}}{1960}\approx 82\ \text{yr}
  \]

So the astronaut ages only about 81–82 years during the trip, arriving around age 103–104, below the 150-year lifespan. The closest choice is 81 years.
